column4: cinematic: the sedan has slammed into the back of a container lorry and bursts into a huge fireball explosion, flames billowing, debris and sparks flying, heavy rain, camera shakes, realistic live action
cinematic: firefighters walk toward a burning car wreck and spray water from a hose, smoke rising, flames flickering, blue and red police lights flashing, heavy rain, slow tracking camera, realistic
cinematic close-up: rain drops splash on a burnt ID card lying on the wet road, orange firelight flickers across it, smoke drifts, slow push in, realistic
cinematic: crowd dancing energetically in a luxury nightclub, neon lights pulsing and sweeping to the beat, haze, camera glides forward through the crowd, realistic
cinematic: the blonde woman raises a champagne glass toward camera, smirks arrogantly and talks confidently, eyes narrowing, head tilting, neon lights pulsing behind her, realistic
cinematic: the woman with short burgundy hair takes a drag of her cigarette, exhales smoke and laughs while talking, expressive face and eyes, neon nightclub lights behind, realistic

cinematic: two women in dark dresses walk away from camera through an empty underground parking garage, heels clicking, slightly unsteady, fluorescent lights flickering, camera follows behind them, realistic
cinematic: in an empty underground parking garage the fluorescent ceiling lights switch off one by one toward the camera until it is almost dark, eerie, static camera, realistic
cinematic: a figure in a black hooded raincoat and black mask steps out of the darkness and rushes toward camera in an underground parking garage, menacing, realistic thriller
cinematic close-up: a gloved hand squeezes a stun gun and bright blue electric sparks crackle between its prongs, the light flickering in the dark, realistic
cinematic: a black van speeds away through the underground parking garage toward the exit, red tail lights glowing, tyres screeching, realistic
cinematic: a hooded masked woman stands in the rain at night with her back to us, then slowly turns her head toward camera, rain falling, city lights blurred behind, realistic thriller
